title: 271. Text Justification

examples.explanation: The first two lines spread extra blanks across gaps; the last line is left-aligned.
The long word fills its own line with trailing blanks.

hints: Greedily pack words: keep adding while the total letters plus minimum single spaces fits maxWidth.
For justified lines, compute total blanks and share them as (blanks / gaps) with the first (blanks % gaps) gaps getting one extra.
Left-align the last line and any single-word line: join with single spaces then pad the end.
